forms.label: Whole, raw
forms.sourceNote: Lemons, raw, without peel. Public domain. The one-fruit weight (58 g) is the record's own portion for a whole fruit without seeds; nutrition is the pulp figure, since USDA carries no whole-fruit-with-peel record, which understates fibre slightly for a twist that uses only the peel. No density: a lemon is not poured, and where a recipe uses only the peel the line states how little of the fruit reaches the drink.
